# Miller & Wagner, LLP

> > Oregon-based medical malpractice law firm specializing in birth injuries, surgical errors, and wrongful death claims with experienced trial attorneys.

Miller & Wagner, LLP is a Portland-based plaintiff representation firm founded in 2000, focusing exclusively on medical malpractice and negligence cases across Oregon and Washington. The firm's attorneys have deep expertise in complex injury cases including birth trauma, brain injuries, spinal cord damage, and surgical complications.

- Medical Malpractice
- Birth Injuries
- Surgical Errors
- Hospital Negligence

- Spinal Cord Injury

- Portland
- Plaintiff Representation
